value.basis: Anchored on Salthouse-style letter/pattern comparison and WAIS Symbol Search norms (young adults ~1.5–2 s per 3-element comparison at ~93–95% accuracy), adjusted for a self-paced keyboard version with immediate next-trial onset (faster than paper) but unordered set matching (slower than string matching) and an error penalty that trims scores for fast-guessers; roughly 48–52 attempts yielding ~45 correct minus ~3 errors, with extra between-person spread from unproctored online speed–accuracy trade-offs.
